title: 1996 AHSME Problem 26

solutions.text: Equal probabilities have the same common denominator, so their favorable selection counts satisfy \(\binom r4=w\binom r3\) \(=wb\binom r2=wbgr.\) Successive ratios give \(w=\frac{r-3}{4},\) \(b=\frac{r-2}{3},\) and \(g=\frac{r-1}{2}.\) The least \(r\ge4\) making all three positive integers is \(r=11.\) Then \((w,b,g)=(2,3,5),\) for \(11+2+3+5=21\) marbles. Thus the correct answer is B.
hints: Let the four color counts be \(r,w,b,g\) and equate the combination counts for the four events
Successive ratios determine \(w,b,g\) in terms of \(r\); then find the smallest \(r\) making all three integers
